Ensure that data from the first month is used only as a baseline for calculating previous total balance, and exclude it from the final output. Sort the results in ascending order by month.

-- Verify the txn_amount type and ensure we get integer results
WITH monthly_net AS (
    SELECT customer_id, 
           substr(txn_date, 1, 7) as month,
           SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                    WHEN txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -txn_amount 
                    WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
                    ELSE 0 END) as net_amount
    FROM customer_transactions 
    GROUP BY customer_id, substr(txn_date, 1, 7)
),
cumulative AS (
    SELECT customer_id, month, net_amount,
           SUM(net_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month) as cumulative_balance
    FROM monthly_net
),
monthly_total AS (
    SELECT month, 
           SUM(cumulative_balance) as total_balance
    FROM cumulative
    GROUP BY month
),
shifted AS (
    SELECT month,
           LAG(total_balance) OVER (ORDER BY month) as prev_month_total
    FROM monthly_total
)
SELECT month,
       CAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(prev_month_total, 0), 0) AS INTEGER) as total_balance
FROM shifted
WHERE month != (SELECT MIN(month) FROM monthly_total)
ORDER BY month
